materials.heading: Okokwakha okujwayelekile
materials.lead: Okokwakha okungu-{count} kumtapo ojwayelekile we-Glazecalc, kusukela ku-feldspar nobumba kuya ku-frit nemithombo ye-boron, ngakunye nokuhlaziywa kwako kwe-oxide nezingozi zakho.
materials.intro: Yonke iresiphi ku-Glazecalc ingasebenzisa lokhu okokwakha. Ikhasi ngalinye linikeza ukuhlaziywa kwe-oxide nesabelo se-unity i-Glazecalc esebenza ngakho, izingozi njengoba umtapo uzirekhoda, nalapho izibalo zivela khona.
materials.careAbout: Ngaphambi kokuthi uthinte noma yikuphi okokwakha kwe-glaze, funda <mixing>Ukuxuba ngokuphepha nomoya ohlanzekile</mixing> futhi <home>Ungawadliseli ushevu umndeni wakho</home>.
materials.own: Okokwakha kwakho, okulondolozwe ku-akhawunti yakho, kusekhasini <own>Okokwakha</own>. <cones>Ishadi lama-cone</cones> libala amazinga okushisa ama-cone.

material.lead: Okokwakha okujwayelekile kumtapo we-Glazecalc: ukuhlaziywa kwako kwe-oxide, isabelo se-unity nezingozi.
material.analysisPercent: I-Glazecalc inokuhlaziywa kwe-{name} njengephesenti lesisindo sokokwakha okuluhlaza. Isabelo se-unity singama-mole e-oxide ngayinye enanini le-{name} eliqukethe i-mole engu-1.0 ye-flux, okuyindlela i-Glazecalc eyengeza ngayo ku-unity formula yeresiphi.
material.analysisMolecular: I-Glazecalc inokuhlaziywa kwe-{name} njengama-mole e-oxide ngayinye eshisiwe ku-formula ngayinye. Isabelo se-unity singama-mole e-oxide ngayinye enanini le-{name} eliqukethe i-mole engu-1.0 ye-flux, okuyindlela i-Glazecalc eyengeza ngayo ku-unity formula yeresiphi.
material.noFlux: I-{name} ayinayo i-oxide ye-flux, ngakho isabelo sayo se-unity singesika-formula njengoba ibhaliwe.
material.weightsNote: Isisindo esilinganayo singamagremu e-{name} aqukethe i-mole engu-1.0 ye-flux. Isisindo esishisiwe yilokho okusalayo kulokho ngemva kokushisa.
material.weightsNoteLittleFlux: Isisindo esilinganayo singamagremu e-{name} aqukethe i-mole engu-1.0 ye-flux. I-{name} ine-flux encane kuphela, ngakho isisindo sayo esilinganayo sikhulu, futhi nezabelo zayo ze-unity zinkulu. Isisindo esishisiwe yilokho okusalayo kulokho ngemva kokushisa.
material.weightsNoteNoFluxFormula: I-{name} ayinayo i-flux, ngakho isisindo sayo esilinganayo yisisindo se-formula yayo njengoba ibhaliwe, ngamagremu. Isisindo esishisiwe yilokho okusalayo kulokho ngemva kokushisa.
material.weightsNoteNoFluxAnalysis: I-{name} ayinayo i-flux, ngakho isisindo sayo esilinganayo singu-100 g, inani okunikezwe ngalo ukuhlaziywa kwayo. Isisindo esishisiwe yilokho okusalayo kulokho ngemva kokushisa.
material.noAnalysis: I-Glazecalc ayikwazanga ukuthola ukuhlaziywa kwalokhu okokwakha.
material.noHazards: Umtapo awunaso isitatimende sengozi salokhu okokwakha. Bheka ishidi lemininingwane yokuphepha elivela kumphakeli wakho.
material.hasLead: Lokhu okokwakha kuqukethe i-lead oxide (PbO), umthofu (lead, Pb).
material.care: I-Glazecalc ibonisa amagama engozi njengoba irekhodi lomtapo liwanikeza. Akukona ukuhlolwa okugcwele kwengozi, ngakho funda ishidi lemininingwane yokuphepha elivela kumphakeli wakho. Ngaphambi kokuthi uthinte noma yikuphi okokwakha kwe-glaze, funda <mixing>Ukuxuba ngokuphepha nomoya ohlanzekile</mixing> futhi <home>Ungawadliseli ushevu umndeni wakho</home>.
material.use: Engeza i-{name} eresiphini ku-calculator ye-Glazecalc ukuze ubone ukuthi yenzani ku-unity formula ye-glaze.

cones.heading: Ishadi lama-cone: ama-cone e-Orton ne-SK
cones.lead: Amazinga okushisa i-Glazecalc ewasebenzisela ama-cone e-Orton ne-SK (pyrometric cones), ngo-°C nango-°F, nejubane lokushisa elenzelwe wona nalapho isibalo ngasinye sivela khona.
cones.intro: Ama-cone alinganisa i-heatwork, okuyizinga lokushisa nesikhathi ndawonye, hhayi izinga lokushisa lodwa. Izinga lokushisa le-cone lincike ekutheni i-kiln ishisa ngokushesha kangakanani ngasekupheleni, ngakho ishadi ngalinye ngezansi lisho ijubane lalo. Beka i-witness cone ku-kiln uyifunde, noma ngabe ishadi lithini. <firing>Indlela yokukhetha, ukubeka nokufunda ama-cone</firing> isemhlahlandleleni wokushisa.
cones.ortonCaption: Ama-cone e-Orton, 022 kuya ku-15: ama-cone amakhulu ashiswa ngo-{rate} °C ngehora ({rateF} °F ngehora)
cones.above: I-Orton yenza nama-cone kusukela ku-16 kuya ku-42. I-Orton ayishicileli zinga lokushisa lawo, futhi alikho ishadi esalithola elinikeza elilodwa, ngakho akukho okuboniswayo: {list}.
cones.publishedIntro: Ishadi le-Orton lika-{year} lama-cone 022 kuya ku-14 linikeza izinga lokushisa ngejubane ngalinye lokushisa, phakathi nama-100 °C okugcina okushisa. Izibalo zehluka kancane kunezeshadi elingenhla, i-Glazecalc elisebenzisela ukuhlola ama-cone.
cones.publishedCaption: Ama-cone e-Orton, 022 kuya ku-14: amazinga okushisa ngo-°{unit}, ngohlobo lwe-cone nangejubane lokushisa
cones.largeDiffers: Ama-cone amakhulu 13 no-14 enziwa ngendlela ehlukile, anezilinganiso zawo zezinga lokushisa.
cones.skCaption: Ama-cone e-SK, 022 kuya ku-20: amazinga okushisa okugoba aqokiwe (JIS R 8101)
cones.skIntro: Ama-cone e-SK (Seger) athengiswa eJapan ngaphansi kwendinganiso {standard}. Izibalo ngamazinga okushisa okubhekisela kuwo endinganiso njengoba umthengisi ewaphrinta, hhayi lokho i-kiln ezokubonisa.
cones.skSource: Umthombo: {seller}, ithebula lamazinga okushisa okugoba ajwayelekile.
